am/aiprepare-diff-command.description: sr submit --aiprepare references the diff by command instead of embedding it

am/fix-ai-spawn.description: Pipe the request to spawned Claude sessions instead of -p, and surface it under --debug/--dry-run

am/submit-covers-every-branch.description: submit creates a PR for every branch it pushes, and --aiprepare describes the whole job

context.text: ensurePR loops over the whole pushed set rather than just current; buildPushSet already orders bottom-up so each base has a PR before its child is opened
PrepareAI derives its branch set from buildPushSet, the same function Submit uses, so the job described to an agent and the job performed cannot drift apart

Only the target branch takes --title/--body. One title describes one change, so propagating it to an ancestor would mislabel that ancestor's PR; ancestors are prompted separately, or reported as gaps when non-interactive
